claims.statement: Timesheet status enum: pending_approval, approved, rejected; payment status enum: pending, paid, failed, cancelled; a force_payroll flag overrides the typical approval gate for rows the admin wants to push through despite a missing step.

Timesheet validation covers daily hours, daytype, status, zero-rate, and assignment (the employee must have a project_employees assignment covering the timesheet date), and is split per concern across timesheet_validation_*.go and timesheet_domain_service_*.go.
Migration 004 added timesheets.transaction_id with index idx_timesheets_transaction_id so each timesheet can reference its revenue transaction.
Edit requests use AllowedEdit (whether the row is editable at all) and RequestEditID (the pending request id) with mutual exclusion between the pending edit and the row being edited.
Bulk operations acquire a per-project lock so a BCC import cannot collide with an in-flight bulk approve; partial success is supported with per-row import errors and Vietnamese messages.

The timesheet transaction_orchestrator is the canonical user of domain.TransactionManager.RunInTransaction for multi-aggregate writes (timesheet + ledger + event); cache invalidation runs as an after-commit callback per ADR-007.

GET /api/v1/timesheets/cash-readiness is advisory-only and cannot initiate a top-up or payment; reliability fields are measured only from unfiltered company forecasts resolved against distinct timesheets in generated weekly transfer files.

GET /api/v1/timesheets/summary reports pendingPaymentAmount and pendingEmployees (pending-approval or approved timesheets with payment_status pending/failed) for dashboard display, while the status=pending_payment list filter and bulk-transfer planner use the stricter payroll-ready cohort (approved with payment_status pending/failed) so pending-approval rows never enter payment exports.
